# DroidSansFallbackFull

`DroidSansFallbackFull.ttf` is bundled for offline, searchable single-page vector PDF exports. The bundled font file is unchanged; exported PDFs embed a subset of the glyphs they use. This font does not cover all Unicode characters. If a glyph is missing, the export dialog reports it and lets the user select an embeddable local TrueType font for that export.

- Source: Android Open Source Project, [`platform/frameworks/base`, tag `android-4.4_r1`, `data/fonts/DroidSansFallbackFull.ttf`](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/android-4.4_r1/data/fonts/DroidSansFallbackFull.ttf).

The Xiaohongshu mini-tool package omits this font and the PDF backend because its container cannot save PDFs.
